name: Heard
summary: Keeps what your wearable recorder transcribed as searchable conversations. Text only, never audio. It stays on this computer, and a model reads only when you ask.
author: The JimmyHQ project

inbound.name: conversation
inbound.label: Omi: Memory Creation Webhook
inbound.help: A finished conversation, as Omi's memory-creation webhook sends it: one JSON object with its lines, title and overview. Its ?uid= is kept. Text only: any audio in a message is ignored.

inbound.name: live
inbound.label: Omi: Real-Time Transcript Webhook
inbound.help: Lines as they are said, as Omi's real-time webhook sends them: a bare JSON list, with ?session_id= and ?uid= in the address. Text only: any audio in a message is ignored.

inbound.name: transcript
inbound.label: Other senders: transcripts
inbound.help: What any other recorder or app sends when it has words to keep: a finished conversation, a batch of live transcript, or one line of text. Text only: any audio in a message is ignored.

settings.label: A conversation ends after this much quiet (minutes)
settings.help: Live transcript and single lines are stitched into one conversation until nothing has arrived for this long. The next words start a new conversation.

settings.label: Keep conversations for (days)
settings.help: Conversations that ended longer ago than this are deleted for good, once a day. 0 keeps everything.

settings.label: Only accept this recorder id
settings.help: Omi adds the id of its user to each message (?uid=). Type that id here and Heard keeps only messages that carry it, and refuses the rest. Empty keeps every message, and the id is stored with each conversation.

settings.label: Skip what the recorder marked as discarded
settings.help: Some recorders flag a conversation as not worth keeping. When on, those are not stored.

settings.label: Let a model read my conversations
settings.help: When on, Summarise and Pull out to-dos send one conversation to a model on your own computer, and only when you press the button. Never a hosted model. Off, no model ever reads anything.

settings.label: Also add accepted to-dos to my tasks
settings.help: An accepted to-do is always kept in Heard. When on, it is also added to your task list with its title only. A task is part of your record, so the title you accept goes there. On by default, because accepting it is your own click; turn it off and an accepted to-do stays in Heard only.

settings.label: Keep the to-dos the recorder itself lists
settings.help: Some recorders list action items of their own. They are kept, marked "from your recorder, not checked", because Heard cannot tell whether the conversation says them. Off, they are left out. Either way, none becomes yours until you accept it.

settings.label: Most to-dos suggested at once
settings.help: The most that Pull out to-dos proposes from one conversation.

settings.label: Clock slack for a recorder (minutes)
settings.help: A time a recorder gives is kept no later than the moment its message arrived plus this much, so a clock set far ahead cannot make a conversation look newer than it is, and so outlast "Keep conversations for". Raise it only if a recorder's clock runs ahead.

settings.label: Conversations shown at a time
settings.help: How many conversations the list loads before Earlier.

settings.label: Most search results
settings.help: The most matching lines one search shows.

settings.label: Most characters a model reads
settings.help: A longer conversation is cut to this many characters, from the start, before a model reads it. The page says when that happened.

settings.label: Longest summary (words)
settings.help: A summary is asked to be no longer than this.

settings.label: Shortest supporting quote
settings.help: A suggested to-do must quote at least this many characters of what was said, or it is dropped.
